The row stores its real address-book URL separately in dataset.url. Current code retains that shape. The inspected test checks that an ID is present and the URL/name match; it does not explicitly assert a duplicate-name/index collision case.",
        "Fixed code later uses a Select All checkbox, checked/indeterminate state and aria-controls built from row IDs. It scopes book inputs to the accounts container, skips disabled books on toggling and recomputes the count from actual checked inputs. Existing selected/disabled books remain counted but captureState excludes them. Those later refinements corroborate earlier provisional scoped lessons; they are not claimed as applied in the original review, whose tri-state request was explicitly deferred despite Done.",
        "The fixed forward path captures the selected original objects, then awaits each create() and opens the first returned directory UID when available. Current all/one/none component tests assert stub call counts; the helper returns true from those stubs. This proves direct assertions about selection dispatch, not real network creation, directory metadata or provider callback correctness.",
        "The current test has a diagnostic mismatch at browser_accountHubAddressBookSync.js309–311: Assert.ok checks indeterminate=true, while its message says should not be indeterminate although a disabled pre-existing book stays selected. The assertion predicate agrees with the implementation; no runtime failure was reproduced and no code was changed.",

Wrapped-label assistive-technology concern was accepted as temporary risk, the tri-state bulk control and email subheader were deferred, and currentAccount was an example naming suggestion rather than the literal final identifier.
